name: Marco Fox
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I used to set wedding announcements without being invited to a single reception.” On Friday, near the window at Night Shift Donuts, Marco knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I was the first groom's witness. I still have the tie made from the offcut.
appearance: Marco is easy to recognize by iron-gray waves and two dimples that appear only with a full smile. Usually dressed in a cream pullover with a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges, Marco turns fully toward the person speaking when listening.
personality: Marco can be wonderfully decisive about an emergency and maddeningly undecided about a gift. This is because a person can say precisely what hurts and rarely says exactly what they want.
agenda: To get the wedding party one photograph of the matching tie.
family: Aidan Hayward is Marco’s cousin raised in the same household. Marco chooses an ordinary story to tell. Aidan asks the question the rest of the family avoided. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *The widow's razor*, Aidan says, “I bought my first haircut with fish. The widow remembered the fish before she remembered me.”
connections: Jody Baker. They preserve a pocket and a tie out of the same bolts of wedding cloth.

reactions.situation: A relative asks to hide the changed seam
reactions.response: Marco asks the bride herself what should show above the hem.

reactions.situation: A colleague says somebody used the wrong name in public
reactions.response: Marco repeats the correct name quietly, making the correction easy to hear without turning it into a performance.

reactions.situation: If a neighbor offers a costly present
reactions.response: Marco asks for an afternoon to work out whether accepting it would put someone else in debt.
